name: pam_pwquality
detailed_description: Modern password quality checking module that enforces strong password policies. Validates new passwords against multiple criteria including length, character composition, and similarity to old passwords. Provides comprehensive feedback when passwords fail validation.

parameters.difok: Number of characters different from old password

notes:
Replace pam_cracklib; provides better password quality checking
